title: CITERIFT Stage 04 ACQUIRE bundle observation, version 1
description: Step 8, inherited finding IF-7: the closed, bounded manifest that a committed ACQUIRE records as its bundle observation (obs_kind bundle). It never embeds the Stage 03 capture document or any artifact body: the exact capture.json bytes and every artifact capture.json lists are retained in Investigation Memory as raw content-addressed blobs, named here by digest with their sizes (the capture document's digest is the Stage 03 capture_sha256, the root's capture identity). The variable-length list of retained artifacts is its own canonical blob (bundle-artifact-set). Every field has a schema bound, so the manifest has a fixed maximum size (review/step8/if7_bound.json). Investigation Memory verifies the manifest, the set and every raw blob by hash and size on append and on open; a missing or corrupt one is corruption.

engine.description: The engine whose verified bundle this is.

capture.description: The exact Stage 03 capture.json bytes, retained as a raw blob. open_bundle refuses a capture.json over 4 MiB (citerift.wiki.bundle.MAX_CAPTURE_JSON), so that is its bound.

schema_version.description: The Stage 03 capture schema version the bundle states.

status.description: Stage 03 capture status. Only a verified complete or partial capture is committed (SPEC 9.3).

identity.description: The subject identity the root binds (S-4.1, F-15); capture_sha256 equals capture.blob.

display.description: Display metadata outside the root identity (RT-1).

failure_artifact_count.description: The number of failure_artifacts capture.json lists (retained, in the artifact set).

artifact_set.description: The canonical bundle-artifact-set blob: every artifact capture.json lists, each retained as a raw blob.
